# Phase 1 Pipeline — Databricks Cluster Run

Run this notebook on Databricks cluster. Scripts sourced from workspace path.
For local runs, use `00. MASTER_RUN.R` instead.

```{r setup}
# Databricks workspace path to Codes/ folder
CODES_PATH <- "/Workspace/Users/tajayalath@ua.edu/Drought-indices/files/Codes"
```

```{r packages}
# SPEI installed as cluster library via Databricks UI (Libraries tab).
# No install.packages needed — cluster carries it across all runs.
stopifnot(requireNamespace("SPEI", quietly = TRUE))
message("SPEI available on cluster.")
```

```{r run-flags}
RUN_SPI        <- FALSE  # Script 01: SPI calculation — DONE with country fix 2026-05-04
RUN_SPEI_T     <- FALSE  # Script 02a: SPEI Thornthwaite — DONE with country fix 2026-05-04
RUN_SPEI_P     <- FALSE  # Script 02b: SPEI Penman-Monteith — DONE with country fix 2026-05-04
RUN_DETECTION  <- TRUE   # Script 03: Drought detection
RUN_SANITY     <- FALSE  # Script 04: Sanity checks
RUN_REF_PARAMS <- FALSE  # Script 05: Freeze reference period params
RUN_FRIEDMAN   <- FALSE  # Script 06: Analysis 1 — Friedman + Nemenyi
RUN_CROSSPERIOD <- FALSE # Script 07: Analysis 2 — cross-period comparison
RUN_APPENDIX   <- FALSE  # Script 08: Appendix A1 figure
```

```{r step1-spi}
if (RUN_SPI) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 1: SPI Calculation")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "01. SPI_Calculation.R"))
}
```

```{r step2a-spei-thornthwaite}
if (RUN_SPEI_T) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 2a: SPEI Calculation — Thornthwaite PET")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02a. SPEI_Calculation_Thornthwaite.R"))
}
```

```{r step2b-spei-penman}
if (RUN_SPEI_P) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 2b: SPEI Calculation — Penman-Monteith PET")
  message("  Requires: PET_data_prep/ steps completed first")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02b. SPEI_Calculation_Penman.R"))
}
```

```{r step3-detection}
if (RUN_DETECTION) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 3: Drought Detection — All 75 Configurations")
  message("================================================================")
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "03. Drought_Detection.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      err_msg <- paste0(
        "SCRIPT 03 ERROR at ", Sys.time(), "\n",
        conditionMessage(e), "\n",
        paste(capture.output(traceback()), collapse = "\n")
      )
      writeLines(err_msg, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/script03_error.txt")
      message("ERROR WRITTEN TO VOLUME: script03_error.txt")
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r step4-sanity}
if (RUN_SANITY) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 4: Sanity Checks")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "04. Sanity_Checks.R"))
}
```

```{r step5-ref-params}
if (RUN_REF_PARAMS) {
  message("================================================================")

  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "05. Reference_Period_Params.R"))
}
```

```{r step6-friedman}

}
```

```{r step8-appendix}
}
```

```{r pipeline-complete}
message("================================================================")
message("PIPELINE COMPLETE")
message("================================================================")
message("Outputs saved to /Volumes/ or ./Data/:")
if (RUN_SPI)         message("  spi_results.rds")
if (RUN_SPEI_T)      message("  spei_thornthwaite_results.rds")
if (RUN_SPEI_P)      message("  spei_penman_results.rds")
if (RUN_DETECTION)   message("  all_drought_events.rds")
if (RUN_DETECTION)   message("  drought_summary_yearly.csv")
if (RUN_DETECTION)   message("  drought_annual_summary.csv")
if (RUN_REF_PARAMS)  message("  era5_gamma_params_ref1970_1999.rds")
if (RUN_REF_PARAMS)  message("  era5_loglogistic_params_ref1970_1999.rds")
if (RUN_FRIEDMAN)    message("  analysis1_friedman_results.rds")
if (RUN_FRIEDMAN)    message("  analysis1_nemenyi_pairs.rds")
if (RUN_FRIEDMAN)    message("  analysis1_equivalence_groups.rds")
if (RUN_CROSSPERIOD) message("  analysis2_pct_change.rds")
if (RUN_CROSSPERIOD) message("  analysis2_rank_stability.rds")
if (RUN_APPENDIX)    message("  Figures/appendix_a1_event_inspection.png")
```
